routes.name: East Ridge (Iodine Gulch – Bathtub Lakes)
routes.approach: From the Verlot Public Service Center on the Mountain Loop Highway, continue east about 4.6 miles and turn right onto Forest Road 4020 (Schweitzer Creek Road, signed for Boardman Lake/Ashland Lakes/Bear-Pinnacle Lake). routes.name: Raven Ridge Traverse
routes.approach: Hike the trail toward Libby Lake, then leave the trail and climb a loose talus/scree gully to gain the crest of Raven Ridge; a helmet is worthwhile given loose rock in the gully.
routes.descent: From Hoodoo's summit, downclimb the easy scree/talus slope on the peak's flank back to the approach trail near Libby Lake, avoiding a reversal of the exposed ridge crest.

routes.name: West Ridge / West Face (via Boiling Lake)
routes.approach: Reached from the same Crater Creek/Eagle Lakes Trailhead system, branching toward the Boiling Lake basin rather than continuing to Cooney Lake.

routes.name: The Zipper (couloir)
routes.approach: Same trailhead as the Classic Route: park at the Reflection Lake pullout on Stevens Canyon Road when it's open, or at the Narada Falls pullout in winter/spring when the road is snow-gated (a short, steep ~200 ft climb from Narada Falls regains the road). routes.name: The Fly (couloir)
routes.approach: Same as The Zipper: From Reflection Lakes pullout on Stevens Canyon Road (1.5 miles before Snow Lakes Trailhead), hike about 2 miles. Walk briefly along Stevens Canyon Road, then drop into basin toward Tatoosh Creek. Climb up debris triangle and continue to base of couloir system. routes.name: Plan 9 from Outer Space
routes.approach: From the Goodell Creek group-camp trailhead near Newhalem, walk the overgrown Goodell Creek roadbed for about 4 miles to the cairn near the Terror Creek crossing, then climb the Terror Creek climbers' path. routes.name: Windy Peak via Windy Creek Trail (Cathedral Driveway Approach)
routes.approach: From Loomis, drive Toats Coulee Road (FR-39) roughly 22 miles to Long Swamp Campground, then continue about 3 more miles west on FR-39 to the Cathedral Driveway trailhead. The final stretch of road is gravel but reported as smooth/passenger-car friendly.
routes.descent: From the summit, downclimb the short Class 2 scramble to rejoin the trail, then descend the Windy Creek Trail back to the Cathedral Driveway trailhead — watch for the trail junction where this route splits from the Long Swamp approach.

routes.name: AA Col
routes.approach: From the climbers' parking area beside the Icefields Discovery Centre, follow the service road used by the glacier tour vehicles, then leave it and climb the lateral moraine. The moraine path is loose and faint, shifts from year to year, and is marked in places by small cairns; it ends at a rock headwall with a few scrambling moves on loose rock. routes.name: Humphrey's Peak Trail
routes.approach: The trail starts at the far end of the large gravel lot at the Arizona Snowbowl, off the Snowbowl Road, and passes beneath a chairlift before crossing a meadow. In the aspen and pine forest, keep left at the trail register; the right-hand fork heads for the ski lodge. routes.name: East Ridge
routes.description: The classic moderate on Bugaboo Spire, taken at a friendly grade for the position it puts you in. Clean Purcell granite with a well-known gendarme pitch high on the ridge, reached from the Applebee camp above the Bugaboo Glacier.
